items.html: And in this manner likewise, Arich sorted for the Nukva of AVI [Aba ve Ima], and AVI for the need of ZON, all the Malchut that is in them; for this is why these are called kings, since from them all the Malchuts were made. And in this manner likewise, in the ten Sefirot themselves in each and every Partzuf, their sorting followed the aforementioned order. And that which could not be sorted and rise into the world of Atzilut, even to the lower Nukva of ZA, remained in Beria, and from them were afterwards made all the parts of Beria, according to the order of its degrees. And the sparks of Beria cannot be sorted by AVI of Atzilut, for they cannot rise above ZON; indeed they are sorted in the belly of the Nukva of ZA, through the coupling of ZA with her. And there too only Atik of Beria is sorted; and there Arich of Beria is sorted; and in Arich, AVI of Beria are sorted; and so always in this manner. For it is impossible for any part to be sorted above the place of its degree, neither in place nor in time; rather all of them one after the other, both in the order of the degrees and in the order of the time of their correction. And this is explained, and it suffices.
